address: 110/1 Mahannop Road, Sao Chingcha, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok, 10200, Thailand
bio: Renowned for Hainanese-style rice noodles, Kolun.h has been serving locals since 1997. The signature dish comes with rich or clear broth, braised pork, radish and crispy pork belly. Don't miss the peppery-flavoured goat meat in an aromatic herb soup. Expect long queues at peak times....
